We offer **guided tours** of the arboretum for the general public and groups: walks
through the collections —conifers, broadleaf trees, shrubs and palms—, observation of
the flora and fauna, and themed botanical tours by group.

Tours are **by advance booking**. Complete the form and our team will get in touch to
arrange the date and details.
